name: Question 8
problem:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$3$** | **$4$** | **$5$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$30$** | **$25$** | **$20$** | **$15$** | **$12$** |
| ${x}_{3}$ | **$2$** | **$6$** | **$12$** | **$20$** | **$30$** |
| $y$ | $-10$ | $-6$ | $0$ | $4$ | $10$ |

The vector of coefficients of the hyperplane $y={\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}+{\beta }_{3}{x}_{3}$ that best fits the data above can be found using multiple linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?
worked_solution:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$3$** | **$4$** | **$5$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$30$** | **$25$** | **$20$** | **$15$** | **$12$** |
| ${x}_{3}$ | **$2$** | **$6$** | **$12$** | **$20$** | **$30$** |
| $y$ | $-10$ | $-6$ | $0$ | $4$ | $10$ |

The coefficients of the hyperplane 

$$
y={\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}+{\beta }_{3}{x}_{3}
$$

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & 30 & 2 \\ 2 & 25 & 6 \\ 3 & 20 & 12 \\ 4 & 15 & 20 \\ 5 & 12 & 30\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ -6 \\ 0 \\ 4 \\ 10\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.

The vector of coefficients of the hyperplane y=β1x1+β2x2+β3x3 that best fits the data above can be found using multiple linear regression as

[β1β2β3]=(XTX)−1XTy,

where X is the corresponding design matrix and y is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix X in this context?

a
[10−60410]
b
[12345]
c
[1130212256132012141520151230]
d
[11301215132014151512]
e
[13022256320124152051230]

x1 1 2 3 4 5

y −10 −6 0 4 10

The coefficients of the hyperplane

y=β1x1+β2x2+β3x3

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution β^ to the system

[13022256320124152051230]⏞X[β1β2β3]⏞β=[−10−60410]⏞y,

where X is the design matrix, β is the parameter vector, and y is the observation vector.
